coverage.note: Each table reports its own denominator and source-flag coverage. Rates are descriptive frequencies, not calibrated probabilities or a model evaluation.

conditioning_state_excludes: score differential: no play-state score-differential field exists in this nfl_pbp schema
definitions.drive_terminal: last play_id within (season, game_id, drive); result is source series_result
definitions.eligible_pass_run_play: play_type in {pass, run}; down 1-4; ydstogo >= 0; yardline_100 in [0,99]
definitions.first_down_or_touchdown_share: share of resolved third/fourth-down series-terminal rows with result First down or Touchdown; includes punts, field goals and no_play rows by play_type and is not an attempt-only conversion probability
definitions.quantiles: linear empirical quantiles at p10/p90; median is ordinary sample median
definitions.quarter_clock_derivation: game_seconds_remaining - (4 - qtr) * 900 for regulation quarters 1-4; values outside 0-900 are excluded as unknown
definitions.series_terminal: last play_id within (season, game_id, series) when series_result is non-null

limitations: nfl_pbp has no pre-play score differential field in the selected schema; score-conditional rates are omitted rather than reconstructed from future scores.
First-down and drive-terminal outcomes are retrospective source labels; these tables do not establish pregame predictive skill.
The cohort intentionally excludes 2022 weeks 6-9; it is not a blind evaluation set for any model already developed on these seasons.
No tracking files, physical timing cohort, LP game payload, or engine code is consumed.

sources.scope: regular season; 2022 weeks 1-5 and 2023-2025; 2022 weeks 6-9 excluded in SQL

study: Retrospective conditional play and drive distributions from PBP only; no tracking features or prediction claim.
